{{Quote|Do you know what happened on Sarranket?|A patron of the Free Access Grill, to a group of Rebel Alliance agents|<ref name="Abduction" />}}
'''Sarranket''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="Abduction" /> located in the [[Sarranket system/Legends|Sarranket system]], a part of the [[Brevost sector/Legends|Brevost sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" />

{{RPG|''[[The Abduction]]''}}
At some point not long after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents visited<ref name="Abduction" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC Narg">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Narg system/Legends|Narg system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]] on a mission to retrieve the [[Operation 45RA|captured]] [[Musician/Legends|singer]] known as [[Crying Dawn Singer]], who the Rebels believed was being kept at the [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated Administration Center]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Grig]]. On its way from [[Grig Starport]] to the [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated|TGM]] Administration Center, the Rebel team entered the establishment known as [[the Free Access Grill]]. Claiming to be the only business serving [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] on the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentrist]] planet, it mostly hosted patrons who were stuck on Narg due to various reasons and were excited to meet other off-worlders. Upon the Rebels' entrance in the grill [[Cantina/Legends|bar]], one of the patrons asked them whether they knew what had recently occurred on Sarranket.<ref name="Abduction" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sarranket was introduced in ''[[The Abduction]]'', a [[1992]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure authored by [[Chuck Truett]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the adventure, Sarranket is mentioned in dialogue if the player characters enter the Free Access Grill on the planet Narg. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="Abduction" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Sarranket [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square O-15.<ref name="TEA" />
